exeMissing: The executable is not at the expected path
portBusyHint: Close the occupying app or set another port in settings.
alreadyRunningNoPort: The app is already running without the debug port. Fully quit it (including the system tray) and relaunch from VibeHub.
injectorFailed: The RTL injector could not start
proxyRequiredUnavailable: The 'Require proxy' policy is on but the proxy is unavailable; launch was blocked.
offlineFeed: The online feed is unreachable; bundled data is being used.
invalidUpdate: The update file lacks a valid signature and was not installed.
secretError: Working with the OS vault failed
execPolicy: Execution Policy blocks this; adjust it yourself deliberately (we never auto-set Unrestricted).
